item.title: Indirect Prompt Injection: The Complete Guide
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: December 11, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Cybersecurity", "Prompt Injection", "Language Models", "Enterprise AI"]
Summary:
  • Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) is a hidden AI security threat.
  • It uses trusted content to deliver malicious instructions.
  • IPI can cause data leaks and unauthorized actions.
  • It is hard to detect and mitigate.
  • Defenses include validation, filtering, and human review.
  • IPI is a critical vulnerability in AI systems.

item.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
item.description:
Author: The Lasso Team
Date: December 10, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Agentic AI", "Cybersecurity Frameworks", "Enterprise AI Adoption", "Vulnerability Management"]
Summary:
  • Enterprises are adopting fully autonomous agentic AI applications rapidly.
  • These agents perform complex, multi-step tasks beyond text generation.
  • Agentic AI introduces new security risks due to probabilistic reasoning and untrusted inputs.
  • OWASP released a Top 10 framework to address these vulnerabilities.
  • The framework helps identify and mitigate critical risks in agentic AI systems.
  • The article details these risks and offers security best practices.

item.title: AI Discovery Comes First
item.description:
Date: December 11, 2025
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "AI Governance", "Risk Management", "Regulatory Compliance", "Enterprise Technology"]
Summary:
  • Organizations must identify all AI systems they use.
  • AI discovery is key to managing AI risks and compliance.
  • It involves cataloging AI assets across the enterprise.
  • Holistic AI offers tools for comprehensive AI asset discovery.
  • This process supports governance and regulatory adherence.
  • AI discovery ensures responsible and ethical AI use.
